insights.one_liner: Novartis is a Basel-based global medicines company and IND sponsor, with an English-language entry-level engineering job listed in Baarle-Hertog.

culture.text: Huge employer: about 84,902 people on LinkedIn, largest functions research, operations and sales.
Staff mostly studied pharmacy, chemistry, biology or business, at schools like the University of Basel and ETH Zürich.
Works on medicines in areas like cardiovascular, immunology, neuroscience, oncology and gene and cell therapy.

open.text: Novartis is an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one current job here, an entry-level engineering role in Baarle-Hertog, does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Signed a deal worth up to $7.8 billion to license an mRNA autoimmune therapy from China's Abogen.
Agreed a deal worth up to $900 million for a radioligand cancer therapy from China's BoomRay.

worth_knowing.text: Stopped developing an ALS drug after a mid-stage trial failure.
Proposed nuclear safety rules could stall expansion of its Pluvicto cancer treatment.
